register_coco_instances: register a COCO-format dataset with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog using a JSON annotation file and image root directory
register_coco_panoptic_separated: register a separated COCO panoptic segmentation dataset with both instance and semantic annotations into Detectron2
load_coco_json: load a COCO instances annotation JSON file and return a list of Detectron2 dataset dicts
convert_to_coco_json: convert a Detectron2 dataset into COCO JSON annotation format and write it to a file
load_coco_panoptic_json: load a COCO panoptic annotation JSON file and return a list of Detectron2 panoptic dataset dicts
